meta_description:
36K likes, 356 comments - rafaelnadal on September 18, 2026: "Very happy to share this special book, which brings together many memories from my life and career through photographs, some of them published for the first time.

Looking back at all these moments has been very emotional for me. I hope you enjoy discovering this story, both on and off the court, as much as I have enjoyed remembering it.Thank you, @assouline for making this possible!".
